description: Provenance manifest for the Ireland-first rung-1 source layer. Per G7 every row has source_url + sha256 + page + language + subject; per G12 no source PDFs are committed (only derived metadata).
ingest_steps: Set TUATHA_CORPUS_ROOT to the parent corpus path (e.g. ~/dev/cianchosaint/leaving_certificate)
Run python3 sources/ireland_fetcher.py → populates sources/duckdb/tuatha_official_documents.duckdb with rung-1 + rung-2 rows
Each tuatha.dlt.{cat}.{sub}.ncca_{cat}_source generator now emits real rows from the DuckDB
what_this_repo_publishes: Only derived metadata: sha256, page references, learning outcome codes, BAML extraction results, RAGAS scores. NEVER the source PDFs (G12).
